title.zh: 卷八 齊本紀下第八: 世祖武成帝 後主 幼主
title.en: Volume 8 Northern Qi Annals 3: Emperor Shizu Wucheng, Later Rulers, Younger Rulers
title.raw: 卷八 齊本紀下第八: 世祖武成帝 後主 幼主 Volume 8 Northern Qi Annals 3: Emperor Shizu Wucheng, Later Rulers, Younger Rulers

sentences.zh: 世祖武成帝 後主 幼主

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu Wucheng; Later Ruler; Young Ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu Wucheng; the Later Ruler; the Young Ruler.

sentences.zh: 世祖武成皇帝諱湛，神武皇帝第九子，孝昭皇帝之母弟也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wucheng the Grand Ancestor, taboo name Zhan, was the ninth son of Emperor Shenwu and the younger brother of the same mother as Emperor Xiaozhao.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wucheng the Grand Ancestor, taboo name Zhan, was Shenwu's ninth son and Xiaozhao's younger brother by the same mother.

sentences.zh: 儀表瑰傑，神武尤所鍾愛。

translations.literal: His bearing was splendid and outstanding, and Shenwu cherished him above all others.
translations.idiomatic: He was handsome and imposing, and Shenwu doted on him especially.

sentences.zh: 神武方招懷荒遠，乃為帝娉蠕蠕太子庵羅辰女，號鄰和公主。

translations.literal: As Shenwu was then seeking to win over distant and frontier peoples, he arranged a marriage for the Emperor with the daughter of Anluochen, heir of the Rouran, who was titled Princess Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: While Shenwu was courting distant tribes, he had the Emperor marry Anluochen, the Rouran crown prince's daughter, who received the title Princess Linhe.

sentences.zh: 帝時年八歲，冠服端嚴，神情閑遠，華戎嘆異。

translations.literal: The Emperor was then eight years old; his cap and robes were dignified, his bearing serene and lofty, and both Chinese and barbarians marveled at him.
translations.idiomatic: At eight years old he wore his cap and robes with grave propriety; his manner was calm and distant, and both Chinese and foreigners alike were struck with wonder.

sentences.zh: 元象中，封長廣郡公。

translations.literal: In the Yuanxiang era he was enfeoffed as Duke of Changguang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanxiang he was made Duke of Changguang.

sentences.zh: 天保初，進爵為王，拜尚書令，尋兼司徒，遷太尉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was advanced to princely rank, appointed Minister of Works, soon also made concurrently Minister over the Masses, and then transferred to Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the opening years of Tianbao he was raised to prince, made Minister of Works, soon given the concurrent post of Minister over the Masses, and then moved to Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 幹明初，楊愔等密相疏忌，以帝為大司馬，領并州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ganming, Yang Yin and others secretly kept their distance and were wary of him; he was made Grand Marshal and given concurrent charge as Governor of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Ganming began, Yang Yin and his faction quietly shunned him and made him Grand Marshal with concurrent authority over Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 帝既與孝昭謀，誅諸執政，遷太傅、錄尚書事、領京畿大都督。

translations.literal: After the Emperor joined Xiaozhao in a plot to execute the chief ministers, he was transferred to Grand Tutor, put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works, and made overall commander of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Once he and Xiaozhao had plotted the deaths of the ruling ministers, he was made Grand Tutor, Recorder of the Ministry of Works, and commander of the capital district.

sentences.zh: 皇建初，進位右丞相。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was promoted to Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: When Huangjian began he was elevated to Right Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 孝昭幸晉陽，帝以懿親居守鄴，政事咸見委托。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhao went to Jinyang, the Emperor, as a close kinsman, remained to guard Ye, and all government affairs were entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: While Xiaozhao was at Jinyang, the Emperor stayed behind in Ye as imperial kinsman, and every matter of state was placed in his hands.

sentences.zh: 二年，孝昭崩，遺詔征帝入統大位。

translations.literal: In the second year Xiaozhao died; his final edict summoned the Emperor to succeed to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In year two Xiaozhao died, leaving an edict calling the Emperor to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 及晉陽宮，發喪於崇德殿。

translations.literal: When he reached the Jinyang palace, mourning was proclaimed in Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the palace at Jinyang, the funeral rites were opened in Chongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇太后令所司宣遺詔，左丞相斛律金率百僚敦勸，三奏乃許之。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered the appropriate offices to proclaim the final edict; Left Chancellor Hulu Jin led the hundred officials in earnest entreaty, and only after three presentations did he consent.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager had the testament read aloud; Left Chancellor Hulu Jin led the whole court in pressing him to accept, and only after the third plea did he agree.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，以太宰、平陽王淹為青州刺史、太傅、領司徒；

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the second month, Grand Preceptor Prince of Pingyang Yan was made Governor of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the second month, Grand Preceptor Prince of Pingyang Yan was appointed Governor of Qing Province, Grand Tutor, and concurrent Minister over the Masses;

sentences.zh: 以領軍大將軍、宗師、平秦王歸彥為太宰、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Guard, Grand Mentor, Prince of Pingqin Guiyan was made Grand Preceptor and Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard and Grand Mentor Prince of Pingqin Guiyan was made Grand Preceptor and Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以兼尚書令、任城王湝為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, concurrent Minister of Works Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, concurrent Minister of Works Prince of Rencheng Hui was appointed Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 詔散騎常侍崔瞻聘於陳。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Supervising Cavalier Attendant Cui Zhan to go on a diplomatic mission to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Supervising Cavalier Attendant Cui Zhan to Chen as envoy.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，皇太后婁氏崩。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinchou, Empress Dowager Lady Lou died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on xinchou, Empress Dowager Lady Lou died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，青州刺史上言。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Governor of Qing Province submitted a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Governor of Qing Province memorialized the throne.

sentences.zh: 今月庚寅，河、濟清。

translations.literal: This month, on the day gengyin, the Yellow River and the Ji River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: That month, on gengyin, the Yellow River and the Ji River turned clear.

sentences.zh: 以河、濟清，改大寧二年為河清，降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: Because the Yellow River and the Ji River ran clear, the second year of Daning was renamed Heqing, and criminals were granted reductions in punishment according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yellow and Ji rivers had cleared, the second year of Daning was renamed Heqing, and punishments were reduced by degree.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，祔葬武明皇后於義平陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the fifth month, Empress Wuming was buried alongside at Yiping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the fifth month, Empress Wuming was interred at Yiping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以尚書右僕射斛律光為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Vice Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Vice Minister of Works Hulu Guang was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，太宰、冀州刺史、平秦王歸彥據州反。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Grand Preceptor, Governor of Ji Province, Prince of Pingqin Guiyan seized the province and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, Grand Preceptor and Governor of Ji Province Prince of Pingqin Guiyan rebelled and held the province.

sentences.zh: 詔大司馬段韶、司空婁睿討禽之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Marshal Duan Shao and Minister of Works Lou Rui to campaign against him and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Grand Marshal Duan Shao and Minister of Works Lou Rui to suppress him and take him alive.

sentences.zh: 乙未，斬歸彥，並其三子及黨與二十人於都市。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Guiyan was beheaded in the market, together with his three sons and twenty partisans.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Guiyan was executed in the capital market along with his three sons and twenty followers.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以大司馬段韶為太傅；

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was made Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Grand Marshal Duan Shao was appointed Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 以司空婁睿為司徒；

translations.literal: Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Lou Rui was made Minister over the Masses;

sentences.zh: 以太傅、平陽王淹為太宰；

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Prince of Pingyang Yan was made Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Prince of Pingyang Yan was made Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 以尚書令斛律光為司空；

translations.literal: Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 以太子太傅、趙郡王睿為尚書令；

translations.literal: Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was made Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was made Minister of Works;

sentences.zh: 中書監、河間王孝琬為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was made Left Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor of the Secretariat Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 陳人來聘。

translations.literal: People from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁丑，詔兼散騎常侍封孝琰使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the eleventh month of winter, an edict ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Feng Xiaoyan to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, eleventh month, on dingchou, the court ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Feng Xiaoyan to Chen.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen of the twelfth month, the imperial carriage returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the twelfth month, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺太原王紹德。

translations.literal: That year, Prince of Taiyuan Shaode was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince of Taiyuan Shaode was put to death.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥，帝詔臨朝堂，策試秀、孝。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day yihai, the Emperor held court in the Hall of Audience and examined candidates for the cultivated and filial categories.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, first month, on yihai, the emperor presided in the audience hall to test men nominated for cultivated talent and filial piety.

sentences.zh: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wei Shou was made concurrent Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wei Shou was appointed concurrent Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 霜晝下，雨血於太原。

translations.literal: Frost fell by day, and blood-colored rain fell at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Frost came down in daylight, and blood-red rain fell over Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝至晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the Emperor reached Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor arrived at Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，周軍逼并州，又遣大將達奚武帥眾數萬至東雍及晉州，與突厥相應。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Zhou armies pressed on Bing Province, and they also sent the great general Daxi Wu at the head of tens of thousands of men to Dongyong and Jin Province, coordinating with the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhou forces closed on Bing Province, while General Daxi Wu led tens of thousands toward Dongyong and Jin Province in concert with the Turks.

sentences.zh: 是歲，室韋、庫莫奚、靺鞨、契丹並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, the Shiwei, Kumo Xi, Mohe, and Khitan all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from the Shiwei, Kumo Xi, Mohe, and Khitan.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚申朔，周軍至城下而陳。

translations.literal: On the first day gengshen of the first month of spring in the third year, Zhou armies reached below the walls and formed their battle lines.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, first month, on the new moon gengshen, Zhou troops drew up beneath the city walls.

sentences.zh: 戰於城西，周軍及突厥大敗，人畜死者相枕，數百里不絕。

translations.literal: Battle was joined west of the city; the Zhou armies and the Turks were utterly defeated, and the dead among men and livestock lay piled one upon another for hundreds of li without break.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting west of the city, the Zhou and the Turks were routed; men and beasts lay dead in heaps for hundreds of li.

sentences.zh: 詔平原王段韶追出塞而還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao to pursue them beyond the frontier and then return.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao to chase them out of the borderlands and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以律令班下，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the third month, as the statutes and ordinances were promulgated, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the third month the laws were issued and a general pardon was declared.

sentences.zh: 己巳，盜殺太師、彭城王浟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, robbers killed Grand Preceptor Prince of Pengcheng You.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, bandits murdered Grand Preceptor Prince of Pengcheng You.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以司空斛律光為司徒，以侍中、武興王普為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince of Wuxing Pu was made Left Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Minister of Works Hulu Guang was made Minister over the Masses, and Palace Attendant Prince of Wuxing Pu was appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以尚書令、馮翊王潤為司空。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Minister of Works Prince of Fenyang Run was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Minister of Works Prince of Fenyang Run was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，詔兼散騎常侍皇甫亮使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the fourth month of summer, an edict ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Huangfu Liang to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on xinmao, the court ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Huangfu Liang to Chen.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the fifth month, the Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fifth month the emperor came back from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以尚書令、趙郡王睿為錄尚書事，以前司徒婁睿為太尉。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Minister of Works Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works, and the former Minister over the Masses Lou Rui was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Minister of Works Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was made Recorder of the Ministry of Works, and former Minister over the Masses Lou Rui was appointed Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以太傅段韶為太師。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Grand Tutor Duan Shao was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Grand Tutor Duan Shao was elevated to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以太尉、任城王湝為大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Grand Commandant Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Grand Commandant Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand General.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，大雨，晝夜不息，至甲辰乃止。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi of the sixth month, heavy rain fell day and night without cease until the day jiachen, when it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the sixth month torrents fell day and night until jiachen, when they finally broke.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉陽訛言有鬼兵，百姓競擊銅鐵以捍之。

translations.literal: That month a rumor spread in Jinyang that ghost soldiers were abroad, and the common people vied to strike copper and iron to drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jinyang was rife with talk of ghost armies, and people clamored to beat copper and iron in defense.

sentences.zh: 殺樂陵王百年。

translations.literal: Prince of Leling Bainian was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Leling Bainian was put to death.

sentences.zh: 歸宇文媼於周。

translations.literal: Lady Yuwen was sent back to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yuwen was returned to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙丑，封皇子綽為南陽王、儼為東平王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou of the ninth month of autumn, the princes Chuo and Yan were enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang and Prince of Dongping respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, ninth month, on yichou, Prince Chuo was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang and Prince Yan as Prince of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 是月，歸閻媼於周。

translations.literal: That month, Lady Yan was sent back to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lady Yan was returned to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 陳人來聘。

translations.literal: People from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇幽州，入長城，虜掠而還。

translations.literal: The Turks raided You Province, entered the Great Wall, plundered, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks struck You Province, broke through the Great Wall, looted the countryside, and retreated.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，詔遣十二使巡行水澇州，免其租調。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the intercalary month, an edict dispatched twelve commissioners to inspect flood-stricken provinces and remit their land tax and labor levies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the intercalary month, twelve envoys were sent to tour flood-hit provinces and exempt their rents and corvée.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，突厥寇幽州。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Turks raided You Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Turks attacked You Province.

sentences.zh: 周軍三道並出，使其將尉迥寇洛陽，楊摽入軹關，權景宣趣懸瓠。

translations.literal: Zhou armies advanced in three columns: their general Yuwen Yong besieged Luoyang, Yang Biao entered Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan pressed on Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou forces moved on three routes: Yuwen Yong threatened Luoyang, Yang Biao entered Zhiguan Pass, and Quan Jingxuan marched on Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，迥等圍洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the eleventh month of winter, Yong and the others besieged Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, eleventh month, on jiawu, Yong and his men encircled Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔兼散騎常侍劉逖使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Liu Ti to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Liu Ti to Chen.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太尉婁睿大破周軍於軹關，禽楊摽。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Grand Commandant Lou Rui routed the Zhou armies at Zhiguan Pass and captured Yang Biao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Grand Commandant Lou Rui crushed the Zhou at Zhiguan Pass and took Yang Biao prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，豫州刺史王士良以城降周將權景宣。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the twelfth month, Governor of Yu Province Wang Shiliang surrendered the city to the Zhou general Quan Jingxuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the twelfth month, Governor of Yu Province Wang Shiliang handed the city to Zhou general Quan Jingxuan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，帝自晉陽南討。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Emperor marched south from Jinyang on a punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the emperor led a southern expedition from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，太宰、平陽王淹薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Grand Preceptor Prince of Pingyang Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Grand Preceptor Prince of Pingyang Yan died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太師段韶大破尉迥等，解洛陽圍。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao routed Yuwen Yong and the others and lifted the siege of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao broke Yuwen Yong's force and relieved Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝至洛陽，免洛州經周軍處一年租賦；

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Emperor reached Luoyang and remitted one year's land tax and levies from areas in Luo Province that had suffered Zhou invasion;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor entered Luoyang and waived a year's taxes in Luo Province wherever Zhou armies had passed;

sentences.zh: 赦州城內死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: prisoners within the provincial capital down to those guilty of capital crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: and all prisoners in the city below the rank of capital offense were released.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以太師段韶為太宰，以司徒斛律光為太尉，并州刺史、蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was made Grand Preceptor, Minister over the Masses Hulu Guang was made Grand Commandant, and Governor of Bing Province Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was made Grand Preceptor, Minister over the Masses Hulu Guang was appointed Grand Commandant, and Governor of Bing Province Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帝至武牢，經滑臺，次於黎陽。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Emperor reached Wu Fort, passed through Huatai, and halted at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor came to Wu Fort, went by Huatai, and stopped at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 所經減降罪人。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed, punishments were reduced for criminals.
translations.idiomatic: Along the route he lightened sentences for offenders.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕至自洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the imperial carriage returned from Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor returned from Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、靺鞨、新羅並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Mohe, and Silla all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Goguryeo, Mohe, and Silla.

sentences.zh: 山東大水，饑死者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Great floods struck the eastern provinces, and those who died of famine were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The east was inundated, and famine deaths were numberless.

sentences.zh: 詔發振給，事竟不行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered relief grain to be issued, but when the matter was finished it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Relief grain was ordered distributed, but in the end nothing was delivered.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，以大將軍、任城王湝為大司馬。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day guimao, Grand General Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year four, first month, on guimao, Grand General Prince of Rencheng Hui was appointed Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Emperor visited Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，詔以新羅國王金真興為使持節、東夷校尉、樂浪郡公、新羅王。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin of the second month, an edict appointed King Jinzhenxing of Silla as Bearer of the Staff, Commandant of the Eastern Barbarians, Duke of Lelang Commandery, and King of Silla.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the second month, King Jinzhenxing of Silla was given the titles Bearer of the Staff, Commandant of the Eastern Barbarians, Duke of Lelang, and King of Silla.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以年谷不登，禁酤酒。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, because the year's harvest had failed, the sale of wine was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, with the crops ruined, wine was banned from sale.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔減百官食廩各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict reduced the grain stipends of the hundred officials, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict cut the grain rations of officials by degree.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，詔給西兗、梁、滄、趙州，司州之東郡、陽平、清河、武都。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the third month, an edict granted grain to Xi Yan, Liang, Cang, and Zhao provinces, and to Dong Commandery, Yangping, Qinghe, and Wudu in Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the third month, grain was allotted to Xi Yan, Liang, Cang, and Zhao, and to Dong Commandery, Yangping, Qinghe, and Wudu in Si Province.

sentences.zh: 冀州之長樂、勃海遭水澇之處貧下戶粟各有差。

translations.literal: Poor households in flood-stricken parts of Changle and Bohai in Ji Province received grain in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished families in the flooded districts of Changle and Bohai in Ji Province were given grain by household, each allotment differing.

sentences.zh: 家別斗升而已，又多不付。

translations.literal: It was only a few sheng per household by category, and in many cases even that was never paid out.
translations.idiomatic: The grant was merely a few sheng per household, and often even that never reached them.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗星見。

translations.literal: That month a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet was seen.

sentences.zh: 有物隕於殿廷。

translations.literal: Something fell in the palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: An object fell into the palace court.

sentences.zh: 如赤漆鼓，帶小鈴。

translations.literal: It was like a red-lacquered drum with small bells attached.
translations.idiomatic: It resembled a crimson lacquered drum hung with little bells.

sentences.zh: 殿上石自起，兩兩相對。

translations.literal: Stones in the hall rose of themselves, two by two facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Stones in the hall lifted on their own and stood paired face to face.

sentences.zh: 又有神見於後園萬壽堂前山穴中，其體壯大，不辨其面，兩齒絕白，長出於唇。

translations.literal: A spirit also appeared in a mountain cave before Wanshou Hall in the rear garden; its body was huge, its face could not be made out, and two teeth, utterly white, projected beyond the lips.
translations.idiomatic: A spirit showed itself in a hillside cave before Wanshou Hall in the rear garden: massive in form, face indistinct, with two snow-white teeth thrust past the lips.

sentences.zh: 帝直宿嬪御已下七百人咸見焉。

translations.literal: All seven hundred women from the consorts down whom the Emperor kept on overnight duty likewise saw it.
translations.idiomatic: All seven hundred women on overnight attendance, from consorts downward, saw it as well.

sentences.zh: 帝又夢之。

translations.literal: The Emperor also dreamed of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dreamed of it too.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，大將軍、東安王婁睿坐事免。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the fourth month of summer, Grand General Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui was removed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on wuwu, Grand General Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui was dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, people from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 太史奏，天文有變，其占當有易王。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer submitted a memorial that the heavens had changed and the omen indicated a change of ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The court astrologer reported celestial changes whose omen pointed to a change of kings.

sentences.zh: 丙子，乃使太宰段韶兼太尉，持節奉皇帝璽綬，傳位於皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was made concurrent Grand Commandant, and bearing the imperial seal and cord he transferred the throne to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao was also made Grand Commandant and, bearing the imperial seal and cord, abdicated in favor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元為天統元年。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to the first year of Tiantong.
translations.idiomatic: A general pardon was declared and the reign title became Tiantong year one.

sentences.zh: 百官進級，降罪，各有差。

translations.literal: The hundred officials were promoted in rank, and punishments were reduced, each according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were advanced in rank and sentences were lightened by degree.

sentences.zh: 又詔皇太子妃斛律氏為皇后。

translations.literal: An edict also proclaimed the crown prince's consort, Lady Hulu, as empress.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's wife Lady Hulu was also proclaimed empress.

sentences.zh: 於是群公上尊號為太上皇帝。

translations.literal: Thereupon the assembled lords offered him the honorific title Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The great ministers then gave him the title Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 軍國大事，咸以奏聞。

translations.literal: All matters of state and army were still reported to him for decision.
translations.idiomatic: Military and civil affairs were still submitted to him for approval.

sentences.zh: 始將傳政，使內參乘子尚乘驛送詔書於鄴。

translations.literal: When the transfer of power was first planned, an inner attendant named Shang was sent by post relay with the edict to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: As the abdication was being arranged, inner attendant Shang was dispatched by relay to Ye with the edict.

sentences.zh: 子尚出晉陽城，見人騎隨後，忽失之。

translations.literal: When Shang left Jinyang city, he saw men on horseback following behind; suddenly they vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Shang had barely left Jinyang when riders seemed to follow him, then vanished without trace.

sentences.zh: 尚未至鄴而其言已布矣。

translations.literal: Before Shang had even reached Ye, his message was already abroad.
translations.idiomatic: He had not yet reached Ye when word of the transfer was already spreading.

sentences.zh: 天統四年十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩於鄴宮幹壽堂，時年三十二。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the twelfth month of the fourth year of Tiantong, the Retired Emperor died in Qian Shou Hall in the Ye palace; he was thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month of Tiantong year four, the Retired Emperor died in Qian Shou Hall at Ye; he was thirty-two.

sentences.zh: 謚曰武成皇帝，廟號世祖。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Wucheng, and his temple name was Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Emperor Wucheng, with temple name Shizu.

sentences.zh: 五年二月甲申，葬於永平陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the second month of the fifth year, he was buried at Yongping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the fifth year, second month, he was interred at Yongping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 後主諱緯，字仁綱，武成皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: The Later Ruler, taboo name Wei, courtesy name Rengang, was the eldest son of Emperor Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Ruler, taboo name Wei, style name Rengang, was Wucheng's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 母曰胡皇后，夢於海上坐玉盆，日入裙下，遂有娠。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Hu; she dreamed that she sat in a jade basin on the sea and the sun entered beneath her skirt, and thereafter she conceived.
translations.idiomatic: His mother Empress Hu dreamed she sat in a jade basin upon the sea while the sun sank into her skirts, and afterward she became pregnant.

sentences.zh: 天保七年五月五日，生帝於并州邸。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Tianbao, the Emperor was born at the residence in Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the fifth month in Tianbao year seven he was born at the Bing Province lodge.

sentences.zh: 帝少美容儀，武成特所愛寵，拜世子。

translations.literal: As a youth his looks were fine, and Wucheng doted on him especially, appointing him heir.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was handsome, and Wucheng favored him above all, naming him heir.

sentences.zh: 及武成入纂大業，大寧二年正月丙戌，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Wucheng succeeded to the great enterprise, on the day bingxu of the first month of the second year of Daning, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Wucheng took the throne, on bingxu in the first month of Daning year two, he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 河清四年，武成禪位於帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Heqing, Wucheng abdicated the throne to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Heqing year four, Wucheng abdicated in his favor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，狩於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, he hunted at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he hunted at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，狩於西郊。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he hunted at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he hunted at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor came back from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有司奏改高祖文宣皇帝為威宗景烈皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the relevant offices memorialized changing the posthumous title of the Founding Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan to Weizong Jinglie Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu officials proposed changing Founding Ancestor Wenxuan's posthumous title to Weizong Jinglie Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、契丹、靺鞨並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, the Khitan, and Mohe all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Goguryeo, the Khitan, and Mohe.

sentences.zh: 河南大疫。

translations.literal: A great pestilence struck south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Yellow River was ravaged by plague.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day xinmao, sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, first month, on xinmao, he sacrificed at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，祫祭於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, joint sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he performed the joint ancestral rites in the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: An edict reduced punishments for criminals, each according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: An edict lightened sentences by degree.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以吏部尚書尉瑾為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Minister of Personnel Wei Jin was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚子，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the second month, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, people from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，太上皇帝詔以三臺施興聖寺。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the third month, the Retired Emperor ordered the Three Terraces granted to Xingsheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yisi, the Retired Emperor gave the Three Terraces to Xingsheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 以旱故，降禁囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, imprisoned persons were released.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought, prisoners were freed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，陳文帝殂。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Emperor Wen of Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, Chen Emperor Wen died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，以兼尚書左僕射、武興王普為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, concurrent Left Vice Minister of Works Prince of Wuxing Pu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, concurrent Left Vice Minister of Works Prince of Wuxing Pu was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封太上皇帝子儼為東平王，仁弘為齊安王，仁固為北平王，仁英為高平王，仁光為淮南王。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Retired Emperor's sons Yan, Renhong, Rengu, Renying, and Renguang were enfeoffed as Prince of Dongping, Prince of Qi'an, Prince of Beiping, Prince of Gaoping, and Prince of Huainan respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Retired Emperor enfeoffed his sons Yan as Prince of Dongping, Renhong as Prince of Qi'an, Rengu as Prince of Beiping, Renying as Prince of Gaoping, and Renguang as Prince of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 六月，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍韋道儒聘於陳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Retired Emperor ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Wei Daoru to go on a diplomatic mission to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Retired Emperor sent concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Wei Daoru to Chen.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, eighth month, the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，以太保侯莫陳相為太傅；

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the tenth month of winter, Grand Guardian Hou Mo Chen Xiang was made Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, on yimao, Grand Guardian Hou Mo Chen Xiang was made Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 大司馬、任城王湝為太保；

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 太尉婁睿為大司馬，徙馮翊王潤為太尉，開府儀同三司韓祖念為司徒。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal; Prince of Fenyang Run was transferred to Grand Commandant; and Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Han Zunian was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal, Prince of Fenyang Run was moved to Grand Commandant, and Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Han Zunian was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 十一月，大雨雪。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, heavy rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month there was heavy rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 盜竊太廟御服。

translations.literal: Imperial robes in the Imperial Temple were stolen.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial vestments in the Imperial Temple were stolen.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day yichou of the twelfth month, people from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the twelfth month, envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺河間王孝琬。

translations.literal: That year, Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince of Hejian Xiaowan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 突厥、靺鞨國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The Turks and the Mohe state both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came with tribute from the Turks and Mohe.

sentences.zh: 於周為天和元年。

translations.literal: In Zhou this was the first year of Tianhe.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhou it was Tianhe year one.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬辰，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the day renchen, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, first month, on renchen, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大雪，平地三尺。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, heavy snow fell; on level ground it was three feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei snow fell so heavily that level ground lay three feet deep.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太上皇帝詔，京官執事散官三品已上，舉三人，五品已上，各舉二人；

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Retired Emperor ordered that active officials in the capital of the third rank and above each recommend three men, and those of the fifth rank and above each recommend two;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Retired Emperor ordered capital officials of third rank and above to nominate three men each, and those of fifth rank and above two each;

sentences.zh: 稱事七品已上，及殿中侍御史、尚書都、檢校御史、主書及門下錄事，各舉一人。

translations.literal: those of the seventh rank and above with substantive posts, as well as Attendants within the Palace, Directors in the Ministry of Works, Inspecting Censors, Record Clerks, and Gate Recorders, each recommend one.
translations.idiomatic: officials of seventh rank and above with substantive posts, together with palace attendants, ministry directors, inspecting censors, record clerks, and gate recorders, were each to nominate one.

sentences.zh: 鄴宮九龍殿災，延燒西廊。

translations.literal: Fire broke out in the Nine Dragons Hall of the Ye palace and spread through the western corridor.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Dragons Hall at Ye caught fire and burned through the western corridor.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅朔，帝加元服，大赦。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin of the second month, the Emperor came of age and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon renyin in the second month the emperor came of age and a general pardon was declared.

sentences.zh: 九州職人，各進四級；

translations.literal: Craftsmen of the nine provinces were each advanced four ranks;
translations.idiomatic: Artisans of the nine provinces were each promoted four ranks;

sentences.zh: 內外百官，普進二級。

translations.literal: civil and military officials within and without were all advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: and all civil and military officials inside and outside the court were promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍司馬幼之使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the fourth month of summer, the Retired Emperor ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Sima Youzhi to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on guichou, the Retired Emperor sent concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Sima Youzhi to Chen.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，太上皇帝詔以領軍大將軍、東平王儼為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the fifth month, the Retired Emperor ordered General of the Guard Prince of Dongping Yan to be Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the fifth month the Retired Emperor made General of the Guard Prince of Dongping Yan Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大風，晝晦，發屋拔樹。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a great wind blew; daylight darkened, and houses were unroofed and trees uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei a gale blew; day turned dark, roofs were torn off, and trees were uprooted.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，太上皇帝詔封皇子仁機為西河王，仁約為樂浪王，仁儉為潁川王，仁雅為安樂王，統為丹楊王，仁謙為東海王。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the sixth month, the Retired Emperor ordered princes Renji, Renyue, Renjian, Renya, Tong, and Renqian enfeoffed as Prince of Xihe, Prince of Lelang, Prince of Yingchuan, Prince of Anle, Prince of Danyang, and Prince of Donghai respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the sixth month the Retired Emperor enfeoffed princes Renji as Prince of Xihe, Renyue as Prince of Lelang, Renjian as Prince of Yingchuan, Renya as Prince of Anle, Tong as Prince of Danyang, and Renqian as Prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 閏六月辛巳，左丞相斛律金薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the intercalary sixth month, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the intercalary sixth month, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太上皇帝詔尚書令、東平王儼錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Retired Emperor ordered Minister of Works Prince of Dongping Yan to record affairs in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Retired Emperor put Minister of Works Prince of Dongping Yan in charge of recording ministry affairs.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左僕射趙彥深為尚書令，並省尚書右僕射婁定遠為尚書左僕射，中書監徐之才為右僕射。

translations.literal: Left Vice Minister of Works Zhao Yanshen was made Minister of Works; concurrent Right Vice Minister of Works Lou Dingyuan was made Left Vice Minister of Works; and Supervisor of the Secretariat Xu Zhicai was made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Minister of Works Zhao Yanshen was made Minister of Works, concurrent Right Vice Minister Lou Dingyuan was made Left Vice Minister, and Secretariat Supervisor Xu Zhicai was made Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未，太上皇帝詔以太保、任城王湝為太師，太尉、馮翊王潤為大司馬，太宰段韶為左丞相，太師賀拔仁為右丞相，太傅侯莫陳相為太宰，大司馬婁睿為太傅，大將軍斛律光為太保，司徒韓祖念為大將軍，司空、趙郡王睿為太尉，尚書令、東平王儼為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the eighth month of autumn, the Retired Emperor ordered Grand Preceptor Prince of Rencheng Hui made Grand Preceptor, Grand Commandant Prince of Fenyang Run made Grand Marshal, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao made Left Chancellor, Grand Preceptor Heba Ren made Right Chancellor, Grand Tutor Hou Mo Chen Xiang made Grand Preceptor, Grand Marshal Lou Rui made Grand Tutor, Grand General Hulu Guang made Grand Guardian, Minister over the Masses Han Zunian made Grand General, Minister of Works Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui made Grand Commandant, and Minister of Works Prince of Dongping Yan made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in autumn, eighth month, the Retired Emperor appointed Grand Preceptor Prince of Rencheng Hui as Grand Preceptor, Grand Commandant Prince of Fenyang Run as Grand Marshal, Grand Preceptor Duan Shao as Left Chancellor, Grand Preceptor Heba Ren as Right Chancellor, Grand Tutor Hou Mo Chen Xiang as Grand Preceptor, Grand Marshal Lou Rui as Grand Tutor, Grand General Hulu Guang as Grand Guardian, Minister over the Masses Han Zunian as Grand General, Minister of Works Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui as Grand Commandant, and Minister of Works Prince of Dongping Yan as Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，太上皇帝詔諸寺署所綰雜保戶姓高者，天保之初，雖有優放，權假力用未免者，今可悉蠲雜戶，任屬郡縣，一準平人。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the ninth month, the Retired Emperor ordered that among the miscellaneous dependent households attached to the various temples and offices, those surnamed Gao who since the beginning of Tianbao, though given some relief, had still been compelled to labor without exemption, should now all be freed from miscellaneous household status and assigned to their counties and commanderies as ordinary people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the ninth month the Retired Emperor ordered that Gao-surnamed miscellaneous dependent households under temples and offices who since Tianbao had still been forced to labor despite partial relief should now be fully freed and registered as ordinary subjects in their counties.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是秋，山東大水，人饑，僵屍滿道。

translations.literal: That autumn great floods struck the eastern provinces; people starved, and corpses lay piled along the roads.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the east was flooded; famine followed, and the dead filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，突厥、大莫婁、室韋、百濟、靺鞨等國，各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Turks, Damo Lou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mohe, and other states each sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, envoys came with tribute from the Turks, Damo Lou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mohe, and others.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，以晉陽大明殿成故，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu of the eleventh month, because the Daming Hall at Jinyang was completed, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the eleventh month, with the completion of Daming Hall at Jinyang, a general pardon was declared.

sentences.zh: 文武百官進二級。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 免并州居城、太原一郡來年租。

translations.literal: The next year's land tax was remitted for Jucheng in Bing Province and for Taiyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's land tax was waived for Jucheng in Bing Province and for Taiyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，太上皇帝詔以故左丞相、趙郡王琛配饗神武廟廷。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the twelfth month, the Retired Emperor ordered the late Left Chancellor Prince of Zhao Commandery Chen paired in sacrifice at Shenwu's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the twelfth month the Retired Emperor ordered the late Left Chancellor Prince of Zhao Commandery Chen paired in sacrifice in Shenwu's temple.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬子，詔以故清河王嶽、河東王潘相樂十人並配饗神武廟廷。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the day renzi, an edict ordered the late Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan, and ten others paired in sacrifice at Shenwu's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year four, first month, on renzi, an edict paired the late Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan, and ten others in sacrifice at Shenwu's temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍鄭大護使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Retired Emperor ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Zheng Dahu to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Retired Emperor sent concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Zheng Dahu to Chen.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，太上皇帝詔以司徙、東平王儼為大將軍，南陽王綽為司徒，開府儀同三司、廣寧王孝珩為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the third month, the Retired Emperor ordered Minister over the Masses Prince of Dongping Yan made Grand General, Prince of Nanyang Chuo made Minister over the Masses, and Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the third month the Retired Emperor made Minister over the Masses Prince of Dongping Yan Grand General, Prince of Nanyang Chuo Minister over the Masses, and Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，鄴宮昭陽殿災，及宣光、瑤華等殿。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the fourth month of summer, fire broke out in Zhaoyang Hall of the Ye palace, and also in Xuanguang, Yaohua, and other halls.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on xinwei, Zhaoyang Hall at Ye burned, along with Xuanguang, Yaohua, and other halls.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太上皇帝幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Retired Emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，以尚書右僕射胡長仁為左僕射，中書監和士開為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day guimao of the fifth month, Right Vice Minister of Works Hu Changren was made Left Vice Minister of Works, and Secretariat Supervisor He Shikai was made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fifth month, Right Vice Minister Hu Changren was made Left Vice Minister, and Secretariat Supervisor He Shikai was made Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太上皇帝至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Retired Emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 自正月不雨，至於是月。

translations.literal: From the first month no rain fell until this month.
translations.idiomatic: From the first month until now there had been no rain.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子朔，大雨。

translations.literal: On the first day jiazi of the sixth month, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon jiazi in the sixth month torrential rain fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大風，拔木折樹。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, a great wind blew, uprooting trees and snapping trunks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a gale uprooted trees and snapped trunks.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗星見於東井。

translations.literal: That month a comet appeared in the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet was seen in the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 秋九月丙申，周人來通和。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the ninth month of autumn, people from Zhou came to propose peace.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, ninth month, on bingshen, Zhou envoys came seeking peace.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝詔侍中斛斯文略報聘於周。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor ordered Palace Attendant Hulu Wenlue to return the diplomatic visit to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Retired Emperor sent Palace Attendant Hulu Wenlue to Zhou in return.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以尚書令、廣寧王孝珩為錄尚書事，左僕射胡長仁為尚書令，右僕射和士開為左僕射，中書監唐邕為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the tenth month of winter, Minister of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works; Left Vice Minister Hu Changren was made Minister of Works; Right Vice Minister He Shikai was made Left Vice Minister; and Secretariat Supervisor Tang Yong was made Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, on xinsi, Minister of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Recorder of the Ministry of Works, Left Vice Minister Hu Changren was made Minister of Works, Right Vice Minister He Shikai was made Left Vice Minister, and Secretariat Supervisor Tang Yong was made Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，太上皇帝詔兼散騎常侍李翥使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day renchen of the eleventh month, the Retired Emperor ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Li Xu to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eleventh month the Retired Emperor sent concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Li Xu to Chen.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳安成王頊廢其主伯宗而自立。

translations.literal: That month, Chen Prince of Ancheng Xiang deposed his ruler Bozong and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen Prince of Ancheng Xiang deposed Emperor Bozong and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，太上皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the twelfth month, the Retired Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month the Retired Emperor died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a general pardon was declared.

sentences.zh: 九州職人普加一級，內外百官並加兩級。

translations.literal: Craftsmen of the nine provinces were all advanced one rank; civil and military officials within and without were all advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans of the nine provinces were promoted one rank; all civil and military officials were promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上太上皇后尊號為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Retired Empress was given the honorific title Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Retired Empress was given the title Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔細作之務及所在百工悉罷之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered all fine-craft work and artisans in every place to be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict halted all fine-craft work and local artisan labor.

sentences.zh: 又詔掖廷、晉陽、中山宮人等，及鄴下、并州太官官口二處，其年六十已上，及有癃患者，仰所司簡放。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that palace women in the Rear Palace, Jinyang, and Zhongshan palaces, and the two groups of palace servants at Ye and Bing Province, those sixty years old and above and those afflicted with infirmity, be screened and released by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that palace women of the Rear Palace, Jinyang, and Zhongshan, and palace servants at Ye and Bing Province who were sixty or older or infirm, be reviewed and released.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔天保七年已來，諸家緣坐配流者，所在令還。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, an edict ordered that families implicated and exiled since the seventh year of Tianbao be allowed to return wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict ordered families implicated and exiled since Tianbao year seven to be allowed to return home.

sentences.zh: 是歲，契丹、靺鞨國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, the Khitan and Mohe states both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys came with tribute from the Khitan and Mohe.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛亥，詔以金鳳等三臺未入寺者，施大興聖寺。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the day xinhai, an edict ordered the three terraces including Jinfeng that had not yet been granted to temples given to Daxing Sheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year five, first month, on xinhai, an edict gave the Jinfeng and other terraces not yet granted to temples to Daxing Sheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，殺定州刺史、博陵王濟。

translations.literal: That month, Governor of Ding Province Prince of Boling Ji was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Boling Ji, Governor of Ding Province, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，詔應宮刑者，普免刑為官口。

translations.literal: On the day yichou of the second month, an edict ordered that those subject to palace castration be generally exempted from punishment and made palace servants.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the second month, an edict freed those liable to palace castration from punishment and enrolled them as palace servants.

sentences.zh: 又詔禁網捕鷹鷂及畜養籠放之物。

translations.literal: Another edict forbade netting hawks and falcons and keeping or releasing caged birds of prey.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict banned the netting of hawks and falcons and the keeping or release of caged raptors.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大莫婁國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Damo Lou state sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou envoys came with tribute from Damo Lou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改東平王儼為瑯邪王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Prince of Dongping Yan was renamed Prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince of Dongping Yan was retitled Prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 詔侍中叱列長文使於周。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Palace Attendant Chilie Changwen to go as envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Palace Attendant Chilie Changwen to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，殺太尉、趙郡王睿。

translations.literal: That month, Grand Commandant Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Grand Commandant Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，以司空徐顯秀為太尉，並省尚書令婁定遠為司空。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the third month, Minister of Works Xu Xianxiu was made Grand Commandant, and concurrent Minister of Works Lou Dingyuan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the third month, Minister of Works Xu Xianxiu was made Grand Commandant and concurrent Minister of Works Lou Dingyuan was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是月，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: That month, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，詔以并州尚書省為大基聖寺，晉祠為大崇皇寺。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the fourth month of summer, an edict ordered the Ministry of Works office in Bing Province converted to Daji Sheng Temple, and Jin Shrine to Dachong Huang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on jiazi, an edict turned the Bing Province ministry office into Daji Sheng Temple and Jin Shrine into Dachong Huang Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the imperial carriage returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，詔降罪人各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the seventh month of autumn, an edict reduced punishments for criminals, each according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on jichou, an edict lightened sentences by degree.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔使巡省河北諸州無雨處，境內偏旱者，優免租調。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict dispatched envoys to inspect drought-stricken areas in the northern provinces of Hebei and to grant preferential remission of land tax and labor levies where drought was partial within a jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen envoys were sent to tour drought-hit districts in Hebei and to remit rents and corvée where drought was severe.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，詔禁造酒。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the tenth month of winter, an edict forbade the brewing of wine.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, on renxu, wine-making was banned.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，詔以太保斛律光為太傅，大司馬、馮翊王潤為太保，大將軍、瑯邪王儼為大司馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the eleventh month, an edict ordered Grand Guardian Hulu Guang made Grand Tutor, Grand Marshal Prince of Fenyang Run made Grand Preceptor, and Grand General Prince of Langye Yan made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eleventh month, Grand Guardian Hulu Guang was made Grand Tutor, Grand Marshal Prince of Fenyang Run Grand Preceptor, and Grand General Prince of Langye Yan Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，以開府儀同三司、蘭陵王長恭為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month, Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the twelfth month, Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以中書監魏收為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Secretariat Supervisor Wei Shou was made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Secretariat Supervisor Wei Shou was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 武平元年春正月乙酉朔，改元。

translations.literal: On the first day yiyou of the first month of spring in the first year of Wuping, the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wuping year one, first month, on the new moon yiyou, the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 太師、并州刺史、東安王婁睿薨。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor, Governor of Bing Province, Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor and Governor of Bing Province Prince of Dong'an Lou Rui died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔兼散騎常侍裴獻之聘於陳。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Pei Xianzhi to go on a diplomatic mission to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Pei Xianzhi to Chen.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，以百濟王余昌為使持節、侍中、驃騎大將軍、帶方郡公，王如故。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the second month, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, General of Agile Cavalry, Duke of Daifang Commandery, and king as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the second month, King Yuchang of Baekje was given the titles Bearer of the Staff, Palace Attendant, General of Agile Cavalry, Duke of Daifang, and confirmed as king.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以太傅、咸陽王斛律光為右丞相，并州刺史、右丞相、安定王賀拔仁為錄尚書事，冀州刺史、任城王湝為太師。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Hulu Guang was made Right Chancellor; Governor of Bing Province, Right Chancellor, Prince of Anding Heba Ren was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works; and Governor of Ji Province Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang Hulu Guang was made Right Chancellor, Governor of Bing Province and Right Chancellor Prince of Anding Heba Ren was made Recorder of the Ministry of Works, and Governor of Ji Province Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，降死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, prisoners down to those guilty of capital crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi prisoners below the rank of capital offense were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊戌，錄尚書事、安定王賀拔仁薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the intercalary month, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Anding Heba Ren died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the intercalary month, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Anding Heba Ren died.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以開府儀同三司徐之才為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the third month, Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Xu Zhicai was made Left Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the third month, Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Xu Zhicai was appointed Left Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙酉，以廣寧王孝珩為司空。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the sixth month of summer, Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, sixth month, on yiyou, Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以皇子恒生故，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, because of the birth of the prince Heng, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, with the birth of Prince Heng, a general pardon was declared.

sentences.zh: 內外百官，普進二級；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without were all advanced two ranks;
translations.idiomatic: All civil and military officials were promoted two ranks;

sentences.zh: 九州職人，普進四級。

translations.literal: craftsmen of the nine provinces were all advanced four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: and artisans of the nine provinces were promoted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以開府儀同三司唐邕為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict ordered Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Tang Yong made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Bearer of Equal Honor with the Three Excellencies Tang Yong was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，封孝昭皇帝子彥基為城陽王，彥康為定陵王，彥忠為梁郡王。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the seventh month of autumn, Xiaozhao's sons Yanji, Yankang, and Yanzhong were enfeoffed as Prince of Chengyang, Prince of Dingling, and Prince of Liang Commandery respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on guichou, Xiaozhao's sons Yanji, Yankang, and Yanzhong were enfeoffed as Prince of Chengyang, Prince of Dingling, and Prince of Liang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以尚書令、蘭陵王長恭為錄尚書事，中領軍和士開為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Minister of Works Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works, and Central Guard General He Shikai was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Minister of Works Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Recorder of the Ministry of Works, and Central Guard General He Shikai was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，靺鞨遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Mohe sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai envoys came with tribute from Mohe.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以華山王凝為太傅。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Prince of Huashan Ning was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince of Huashan Ning was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the eighth month, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，立皇子恒為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the ninth month, Prince Heng was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the ninth month, Prince Heng was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以司空、廣寧王孝珩為司徒，以上洛王思宗為司空，封蕭莊為梁王。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the tenth month of winter, Minister of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Minister over the Masses; Prince of Shangluo Si Zong was made Minister of Works; and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, on xinsi, Minister of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Minister over the Masses, Prince of Shangluo Si Zong was made Minister of Works, and Xiao Zhuang was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，曲降并州死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, prisoners in Bing Province down to those guilty of capital crimes were partially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi prisoners in Bing Province below capital offense were partially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復改威宗景烈皇帝謚號為顯祖文宣皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the posthumous title of Weizong Jinglie Emperor was changed back to Xianzu Wenxuan Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the posthumous title Weizong Jinglie Emperor was restored to Xianzu Wenxuan Emperor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the twelfth month, the imperial carriage returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the twelfth month the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 詔左丞相斛律光出晉州道，修城戍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Left Chancellor Hulu Guang to go by the Jin Province route and repair fortifications and garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Left Chancellor Hulu Guang to take the Jin Province route and repair walls and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，詔兼散騎常侍劉環俊使於陳。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Liu Huanjun to go as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, first month, on dingsi, the court ordered concurrent Supervising Cavalier Attendant Liu Huanjun to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以百濟王余昌為使持節、都督、東青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander, and Governor of Eastern Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, King Yuchang of Baekje was made Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander, and Governor of Eastern Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，以錄尚書事、蘭陵王長恭為太尉，並省錄尚書事趙彥深為司空，尚書令和士開為錄尚書事，左僕射徐之才為尚書令，右僕射唐邕為左僕射，吏部尚書馮子琮為右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day renyin of the second month, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Grand Commandant; concurrent Recorder of the Ministry of Works Zhao Yanshen was made Minister of Works; Minister of Works He Shikai was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works; Left Vice Minister Xu Zhicai was made Minister of Works; Right Vice Minister Tang Yong was made Left Vice Minister; and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong was made Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the second month, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Lanling Chang Gong was made Grand Commandant, concurrent Recorder Zhao Yanshen Minister of Works, Minister of Works He Shikai Recorder of the Ministry of Works, Left Vice Minister Xu Zhicai Minister of Works, Right Vice Minister Tang Yong Left Vice Minister, and Minister of Personnel Feng Zicong Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，以大司馬、瑯邪王儼為太保。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the fourth month of summer, Grand Marshal Prince of Langye Yan was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, on renwu, Grand Marshal Prince of Langye Yan was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，陳遣使連和，謀伐周，朝議弗許。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Chen sent envoys seeking alliance and proposing a joint campaign against Zhou; court discussion did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Chen sent envoys proposing alliance and a joint attack on Zhou; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 六月，段韶攻周汾州克之，獲刺史楊敷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Duan Shao attacked Fen Province of Zhou and captured it, taking Governor Yang Fu prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Duan Shao took Zhou's Fen Province and captured its governor Yang Fu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，太保、瑯邪王儼矯詔殺錄尚書事和士開於南臺，即日誅領軍大將軍庫狄伏連、書侍御史王子宣等，尚書右僕射馮子琮賜死殿中。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the seventh month of autumn, Grand Preceptor Prince of Langye Yan, by a forged edict, killed Recorder of the Ministry of Works He Shikai at the Southern Terrace; that same day General of the Guard Kudi Fulian, Supervising Secretary Wang Zixuan, and others were executed; and Right Vice Minister of Works Feng Zicong was ordered to die in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on gengwu, Grand Preceptor Prince of Langye Yan forged an edict and killed Recorder of the Ministry of Works He Shikai at the Southern Terrace; the same day General of the Guard Kudi Fulian and Supervising Secretary Wang Zixuan were executed, and Right Vice Minister Feng Zicong was forced to die in the palace.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，行幸晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the eighth month, the Emperor traveled to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai, the emperor went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，以太師、任城王湝為太宰，馮翊王潤為太師。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the ninth month, Grand Preceptor Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor, and Prince of Fenyang Run was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth month, Grand Preceptor Prince of Rencheng Hui was made Grand Preceptor and Prince of Fenyang Run was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己未，左丞相、平原王段韶薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Left Chancellor Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Left Chancellor Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，曲降并州界內死罪已下，各有差。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, prisoners within Bing Province down to those guilty of capital crimes were partially pardoned, each according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu prisoners in Bing Province below capital offense were partially pardoned by degree.

sentences.zh: 庚午，殺太保、瑯邪王儼。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Grand Preceptor Prince of Langye Yan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Grand Preceptor Prince of Langye Yan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬申，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, people from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen envoys arrived from Chen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，罷京畿府入領軍府。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Capital Region Office was abolished and merged into the Guard General's Office.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, the Capital Region Office was dissolved into the Guard General's Office.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕至自晉陽。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the imperial carriage returned from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor returned from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戍，詔侍中赫連子悅使於周。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the eleventh month, an edict ordered Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue to go as envoy to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eleventh month the court ordered Palace Attendant Helian Ziyue to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以徐州行臺、廣寧王孝珩為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing, of the Xuzhou Field Office, was put in charge of recording affairs in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing of the Xuzhou Field Office was made Recorder of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以錄尚書事、廣寧王孝珩為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Recorder of the Ministry of Works Prince of Guangning Xiaoxing was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以右丞相斛律光為左丞相。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Right Chancellor Hulu Guang was made Left Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己巳，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the day jisi, sacrifice was offered at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, first month, on jisi, he sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，追贈故瑯邪王儼為楚帝。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the late Prince of Langye Yan was posthumously enfeoffed as Emperor of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the late Prince of Langye Yan was posthumously enfeoffed as Emperor of Chu.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，以衛菩薩為太尉。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Wei Pusa was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Wei Pusa was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以並省吏部尚書高元海為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Minister of Personnel of the Combined Provinces Gao Yuanhai was made Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Minister of Personnel of the Combined Provinces Gao Yuanhai was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以左僕射唐邕為尚書令，侍中祖珽為左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Left Vice Minister Tang Yong was made Minister of Works, and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was made Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Left Vice Minister Tang Yong was made Minister of Works and Palace Attendant Zu Ting was made Left Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 是月，敕撰《玄州苑御覽》，後改名《聖壽堂御覽》。

translations.literal: That month, an order was issued to compile the Xuanzhou Garden Imperial Digest, later renamed the Shengshou Hall Imperial Digest.
translations.idiomatic: That month work was ordered on the Xuanzhou Garden Imperial Digest, later renamed the Shengshou Hall Imperial Digest.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，詔文武官五品已上，各舉一人。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the third month, an edict ordered civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above each to recommend one man.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the third month, civil and military officials of fifth rank and above were each ordered to nominate one man.

sentences.zh: 是月，周誅冢宰宇文護。

translations.literal: That month, Zhou executed the regent Yuwen Hu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhou executed regent Yuwen Hu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，周人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, people from Zhou came on a diplomatic visit.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, fourth month, envoys arrived from Zhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，誅左丞相、咸陽王斛律光，及其弟幽州行臺、荊山公豐樂。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the seventh month of autumn, Left Chancellor Prince of Xianyang Hulu Guang was executed, together with his younger brother Regional Inspector of You Province, Duke of Jingshan Fengle.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, seventh month, on wuchen, Left Chancellor Prince of Xianyang Hulu Guang was executed, together with his younger brother Regional Inspector of You Province and Duke of Jingshan Fengle.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，廢皇后斛律氏為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin of the eighth month, Empress Hulu was deposed and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the eighth month, Empress Hulu was deposed and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 以太宰、任城王湝為右丞相，太師、馮翊王潤為太尉，蘭陵王長恭為大司馬，廣寧王孝珩為大將軍，安德王廷宗為司徒。
